contract: docs/OVERLAY_UI.md in this repository: a 44px image toolbar, four normal success actions, contextual full-text fallback, one active CSS blur, keyboard disclosures and opaque accessibility fallbacks.

accessibility.evidence: test:glass checks native accessible names, disclosure state, keyboard opening/arrows/Escape, outside dismissal, clipboard fallback and focus restoration. Axe reports zero violations at three widths and in the partial reader and high-contrast selected state. Reduced motion, transparency and forced colors are exercised. These automated observations do not certify accessibility; screen-reader use and native Chrome permission dialogs remain manual.

responsive.evidence: Rendered and inspected the actual extension at 375x812, 768x900 and 1440x900 over light, dark and busy pages. Toolbar bounds stay inside the viewport, opening More preserves its anchor, and a 150% visual viewport keeps the menu reachable. Actual pipeline overlay checks also cover crop, scaling, scroll, resize and image invalidation.

loading.evidence: glass-loading.png shows a short progress row and cancel; the result panel stays hidden. Reduced motion disables the spinner. Actual image/translation suites exercise cancellation and retry.

empty.evidence: glass-empty.png shows actionable no-text feedback with Try again and Close. The real OCR suite also verifies blank speech bubbles and artwork do not fabricate words.

error.evidence: glass-setup.png shows the missing-model recovery state. OCR text remains available through Read text; Open setup opens the actual fixed extension options page without a download. Blocked copy opens a selectable reader. Actual pipeline suites cover missing models and worker interruption.

partial.evidence: glass-partial.png is an explicitly labeled UI replay: a Partial action opens Available translation with complete available text and a specific skipped-text explanation. Normal success has no generic quality warning.

success.evidence: glass-success.png shows Original, Copy, More and Close in one small row with no open result card. Original reveals the image; copy pastes the exact known fixture translation and briefly shows a checkmark. Real OCR/NLLB results are retained in overlay-report.json and context-comic-translated.png.

permission.evidence: glass-permission.png replays concise image-host access feedback pointing to the popup. test:images verifies actual denied/granted host behavior and untrusted page restrictions. The native Chrome permission-grant dialog itself remains untested manually; no browser dialog is represented by this capture.

renderedEvidence.observation: Light page, compact result row and readable opaque translated text. No persistent panel or generic warning.
Dark host page; the pale tool surface retains dark readable controls and leaves the artwork exposed.
Busy host background; a single small glass toolbar is sufficient to distinguish the actions without filtering the image.
More exposes only Translate again and High contrast. Keyboard focus is visible; the toolbar anchor stays fixed.
Available translation opens only after a contextual Partial action. The specific skipped-text note is confined to this reader.
Loading uses the same compact control row, with a cancel icon.
No-text feedback has a visible retry path instead of silent failure.
Missing model has an explicit setup action; recognized source text remains recoverable.
A fixture of the access boundary explains the popup recovery path; native grant UI is outside this capture.

visualRegression: INCONCLUSIVE: no approved matching baseline for this redesign.
limits: Rendering replay does not grade translation quality.
Local fixture timing is not field INP or a cross-device performance guarantee.
Manual screen-reader and native permission-dialog checks remain outstanding.
